A non-collapsible carded surface with an optional header. Use for content panels (checks, results, comments) where {@link Section }'s disclosure behaviour isn't wanted. Sits on `bg-card` with a border and rounded corners.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/layout/Panel.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { Panel } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/components";
```
